component.name: DSH NEXT
component.summary: Agentic coding desktop for DeepSeek Harness (community build)

description.p: DSH NEXT is a community-maintained desktop client for DeepSeek Harness. It is not an official DeepSeek product.
This Flatpak wrapper fetches the unsigned upstream Linux package built by helloshu/auto-builds at install time via extra-data and runs it with the Electron base app sandbox.
